$comment: A consent mechanism is wired (on WordPress, a WP Consent API plugin), but no integration the site runs needs consent: site.consent.categories is empty. A visitor has nothing to choose, so the footer draws no consent control and no status line, and no banner is drawn (SC-030; proposed, for founder approval at contract review). The HTML is consent-not-wired's.
summary: A consent mechanism wired with no category in use: the footer draws no consent control.
